test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The visitors of the restaurant were enthralled by the __dulcet__ tune that the pianist played.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**sweet and soothing**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Dulcet**" is an adjective that is used to describe something that is **sweet**, melodious, **soothing**, or pleasing to the ear, especially in terms of sound or music.
 
• It is often used to characterize soft, gentle, and harmonious sounds that are pleasant and comforting to listen to.
 
• The pianist played a tune that was pleasing to the visitors of the restaurant.
 
• The word "enthralled" suggests that the visitors were captivated or mesmerized by the music.
 
• The sentence overall conveys a positive and enjoyable experience for the restaurant's visitors.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "**unpleasantly rough**", is the opposite of the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• Option 2, "**ear-piercing and loud**", suggests a negative and possibly painful experience for the visitors.
 
• Option 4, "**inaudible and indistinct**", means that the music could not be heard clearly, which contradicts the rest of the sentence.
